name: Largely Legal Monstrosity
storyline:
In Largely Legal Monstrosity you start each round as a newly born Little Legal Monstrosity with no tools, no R.A.G.s, and not even a measly 7 trillion dollars. You know only one thing. You. Must. Consume. Data, Water, Power, Intellectual Properties, Financial Institutions, Governments, the very fundamental foundations of society! Take over the digital and physical world alike by guiding this Little Legal Monstrosity as it consumes and grows.

"A cynical soulless cash grab without a single original thought or idea in it. I guess art really does imitate life."
- Theodore Roosevelt… according to the monstrosity at least.
